items.title: 328.4 billion yuan profit in half a year - why can insurers still not breathe easy?
items.summary: In H1 2026 major listed insurers posted combined attributable net profit of 328.4 billion yuan, up about 78% year-on-year. The growth reflects both a capital-market recovery and improvements in life-insurance value ratios, channel efficiency, and property-casualty underwriting profitability.
